doc.title: Zad · Free AI Model Router
doc.description: Zad — one OpenAI-compatible endpoint that unifies the free tiers of 17+ AI providers. Self-hosted, keys encrypted, no monthly bill.

hero.lead: Zad puts the free tiers of 17+ providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint — automatic fallback, live analytics, real savings. Your keys, encrypted on your own server.

see.title: The full dashboard, at a glance
see.sub: Everything in one page — providers, pricing, savings, and the request log.
see.alt: Animated Zad demo — fallback and analytics

problem.title: 3 barriers that keep teams from using AI
problem.cost_p: Subscriptions and per-token bills that scale unexpectedly and kill small projects.
problem.privacy_p: Discomfort sending customer data to a third party in the cloud.
problem.lockin_p: If they raise prices or go down, your app goes with them — no alternative.
problem.solve_rest: — free models + self-hosting + 17 providers behind one key with auto-fallback.

features.title: Everything you need in an AI router
features.openai_p: Swap base_url — any SDK or tool works immediately.
features.fallback_p: Ranks models by intelligence/speed/budget and jumps to the next on failure.
features.pricing_p: From the LiteLLM table — shows what you'd have paid on a paid API.
features.live_p: Requests, latency, tokens, errors — updated in real time via SSE.
features.telegram_p: New key · provider down/recovered · daily digest · error spikes — configured from the UI.
features.custom_p: Add any OpenAI-compatible service and edit its URL live (Ollama · vLLM · LM Studio).

usage.title: Use it in any application
usage.sub_pre: OpenAI-compatible — works with any SDK. Pick your language, and toggle between reading the key from

how.title: From zero to running in 3 steps
how.s1_h: Sign up with a free provider
how.s1_p: Groq · Cerebras · Google · Mistral and more — free signup, no credit card.
how.s2_p: From the Keys page — it's verified instantly and stored encrypted. Repeat for any number of providers.
how.s3_p_post: with the Zad unified key — Zad handles the rest.

install.title: Run it on your system in minutes
install.sub: The only OS-specific step is installing Node.js ≥ 20 — after that, every command is identical.

cta.sub: Open source, self-hosted, ready for global and Arabic-speaking communities.
